components.css: .ds-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;font:13px Geist,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#776c64);margin-bottom:16px}.ds-input{font:14px Geist,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;min-height:44px;min-width:0;max-width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line,#e9e1d8);border-radius:9px;padding:11px 13px;background:white;color:var(--ink,#453d38);caret-color:var(--accent,#365f58)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#365f58);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:730px){.ds-input{font-size:16px;min-height:48px}}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e9e1d8);gap:4px 18px;margin-bottom:28px}.ds-nav button{font:13px Geist,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;border:0;border-radius:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;padding:14px 2px 13px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#776c64);min-height:48px;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--accent,#365f58)}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{border-color:var(--accent,#365f58);color:var(--accent,#365f58);font-weight:650}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#365f58);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:1000px){.ds-nav{gap:0 15px}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;margin-bottom:22px}.ds-nav button{text-align:left;padding:12px 6px;font-size:12px;min-width:0}}

components.html:
Learn from confirmed entries

Only confirmed records are evidence. Unreviewed suggestions are not explicit preferences.

narrative.northStar: TallyBear's warm cream and green profile
narrative.overview:
The private profile uses the existing TallyBear identity: warm paper, quiet green actions, readable records, and familiar profile navigation. The page gives habits, explicit rules, and their sources room to be inspected and corrected. It keeps Chinese and English labels equally visible across desktop and phone layouts.

This is a code-derived record of the personal-profile surface, not a replacement for the repository's root design document. The normative sources are `src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/personal-profile.css`, `src/components/PersonalProfile.tsx`, and `src/components/ProfileLocation.tsx`; the surface also reuses the profile shell, product memory workspace, and memory history. The frontmatter records the default warm theme. Existing theme variables continue to control the alternate minimal theme.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream surfaces with green selection and action cues.
Context, preferred value, weighted support, and evidence form a visible reading order.
Inline evidence and rule editing preserve the surrounding profile context.
Seven named sections remain available on narrow screens.
Privacy controls have persistent explanations beside native checkboxes.
dos: Do bind profile surfaces and controls to the existing theme variables.
Do keep context, weighted support, and source access beside each learned habit.
Do preserve all seven section labels and full-width product filters on phones.
Do show privacy explanations and explicit location confirmation beside their controls.
Do keep inline correction, source pagination, and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't add decorative eyebrow text above the profile heading.
Don't add a selected left stripe to insight cards or memory rows.
Don't label weighted support as prediction accuracy.
Don't present learned habits as confirmed personal rules.
Don't replace the implemented native privacy checkboxes with undocumented custom switches.
